# Dropout: A Simple Way to Prevent Neural Networks from Overfitting

**Authors:** Nitish Srivastava, Geoffrey Hinton, Alex Krizhevsky, Ilya Sutskever, Ruslan Salakhutdinov  
**Year:** 2014  
**Journal:** JMLR  
**DOI:** [10.5555/2627435.2670313](https://doi.org/10.5555/2627435.2670313)  
**Publisher:** [https://jmlr.org/papers/v15/srivastava14a.html](https://jmlr.org/papers/v15/srivastava14a.html)

**Keywords:** dropout, regularization, deep learning

## Abstract

Dropout is a technique for addressing overfitting in deep neural networks by randomly dropping units during training.
